en.hook: Home weekly. Class A regional drivers.
en.body: No-touch freight on a regional run. You get home weekly, so you can plan your time off the road. If you hold a Class A and want a steady lane with no-touch loads, apply today.

en.hook: No-touch freight for Class A regional drivers.
en.body: Regional lanes, no-touch freight — you handle the driving, not the loading. Home weekly means your schedule has a rhythm. Class A drivers, this run is built around you.

es.body: Rutas regionales con carga sin contacto — tú manejas, no cargas ni descargas. Regresas a casa cada semana, con un horario predecible. Conductores Clase A, esta ruta es para ti.

en.hook: Class A regional. Home weekly, no-touch freight.
en.body: This is a regional seat with no-touch freight and a weekly home time. You drive a steady lane, skip the loading dock, and get back to your family every week. Class A required.
